_comment: 'When this hits a hero' -> TRIGGERED ON_HIT gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (ability-level conditions are checked at resolution, which is what the release notes describe: the trigger fires on hitting a hero and the whole sequence resolves then). 'Each hero puts a card ... and creates a Ponder token ... beginning with you then moving clockwise': PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM handles ONE player per effect (its handler resolves a single hand), so 'each hero' is a SELF pair followed by an OPPONENT pair - put-then-token for me, then put-then-token for them, matching the two-player reading of the release-note ordering. Release note 'heroes will still create a Ponder token even if they do not put a card': the token is a separate unconditional CREATE_TOKEN, and the put's handler early-returns on an empty hand without touching later effects. The puts are authored MANDATORY ('puts', not 'may') as JSON boolean false - this handler tests truthiness of the raw value, so the string "FALSE" would still be optional (sink_below_red precedent). json/tokens/ponder.json exists (END_OF_TURN destroy-self + draw). Fragment is a printed keyword -> card DB keywords field, deliberately NOT authored.
